description: This Java source file defines the NotificationUpdateService, a subclass of WearableListenerService for handling wearable device data events and notifications. It manages connection with GoogleApiClient for data synchronization, handles data change and deletion events, and constructs notifications specific to wearable devices.

classes.name: NotificationUpdateService
classes.description: A service that listens for data item changes and deletions from wearable devices and manages notifications accordingly. It handles connection to GoogleApiClient, processes data changes to display notifications, and respond to dismiss actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and connection callbacks.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles start commands, particularly dismiss actions to remove notifications.

methods.name: dismissPhoneNotification
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient to dismiss notifications by deleting data items.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Processes data change and deletion events, updating or removing notifications accordingly.

methods.name: buildWearableOnlyNotification
methods.description: Constructs and displays a notification on the wearable device with optional dismissal behavior.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Handles actions upon establishing GoogleApiClient connection, such as deleting data items to dismiss notifications.

methods.name: onResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the data item deletion request, logging failures and disconnecting the GoogleApiClient.
